## Checks before merge

- [ ] **No restricted participant data** — no identifiable information, linkage files, consent forms, health information or raw participant recordings, including in logs, screenshots, notebook outputs and test fixtures
- [ ] **No secrets or credentials** — no keys, tokens, passwords, certificates or private keys, in the diff or in the branch history
- [ ] **No assumption of public release** — this change does not make anything public, add a licence, or rely on this repository ever becoming public
- [ ] **New third-party dependencies considered** — licence checked and noted below, or none added
